pillars.name: Product Selection
pillars.method: Reverse Engineering — research backwards from what already sells
steps: Find high-demand products via Kalodata or reverse-engineer TikTok / TikTok Shop (10k+ units sold, viral videos)
Validate pricing via Google Shopping tab (Shopify/DTC brands only; ignore Amazon/eBay/Temu)
Find COGS on Zendrop; cross-check AliExpress for estimate only

pillars.name: Website Optimization
setup: Build product pages with AI page builder (PagePilot); home page in Shopify (no code)
conversion_checklist: Not cluttered; start with Debut theme
Add-to-cart goes to cart page, not straight to checkout
Copy focuses on problems solved + benefits, not features

pillars.name: Online Advertising (Facebook first)
pillars.strategy: Start Facebook; add Google only after $1k/day (Double Whammy)
creative_sourcing: Use already-viral videos for the product
Kalodata: download top revenue videos, edit in CapCut/Fiverr
TikTok: 100k+ view videos, apply virality check, snaptik.com to download

launch_method.name: 3-2-2 ABO
launch_method.structure: 1 campaign -> 1 broad ad set -> 3 videos, optimize for conversions

pillars.name: Logistics & Brand Building
pillars.phasing: Start dropshipping; move to private label/bulk at 15-20 orders/day
workflow: Research & choose supplier by shipping time, niche, branding
rules: Get dedicated supplier contact at 15-20 orders/day
Bulk supplier > 1 year in business; always get samples
Use a 3PL for bulk (no warehouse needed)
